---
name: Feature request
about: A new message type, a new field mapping, or a new API
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**

The real-world use case, not just the feature — e.g. "we receive VXU^V04 immunization
messages and need them as FHIR Immunization resources."

**Message type / field, if applicable**

- HL7v2 message type or field (e.g. `SIU^S12`, or `PID-13` within an already-supported
  type):
- Target FHIR resource/path, if you already know it:

**Sample message**

A real (de-identified/synthetic — never real patient data) message showing the field(s)
populated, if you have one. This is the single most useful thing you can attach — it lets
the mapping table get reviewed before any code is written.
